name: @titanforge/shell
description: An honest, scoped terminal command interpreter over @titanforge/vfs: a real tokenizer/parser (quoting, pipes) and a fixed set of commands (ls/cd/pwd/cat/echo/mkdir/rm/touch/mv/cp/run) that actually read and mutate the virtual filesystem. Not a Linux container, no real processes or npm install — see src/shell.ts for the documented scope.
